name: Central Metal Fabricators, Inc.
old_description: Since 1980, Central Metal Fabricators, Inc. has provided innovative design, fabrication, and assembly services to a diverse range of industries. We stock over 800 different parts, and have the documentation to manufacture thousands more.
about:
Central Metal Fabricators, Inc. (CMF) was founded in 1980 in Farmingdale, New Jersey, beginning as a welding and repair shop. Over more than four decades, the company has evolved into a full-service designer and fabricator of precision components and assemblies.

Operating from a 35,000-square-foot facility, CMF employs approximately 25 skilled personnel dedicated to design, fabrication, and assembly. The shop offers laser cutting, CNC milling, turning, punching, and bending, along with MIG and TIG welding, mechanical and electrical assembly, wire and cable manufacturing, and industrial sewing for strap assemblies. The company stocks over 800 parts and maintains documentation for thousands more, supporting both prototype and production runs.

Approximately 95 percent of CMF’s work serves the United States Armed Forces, with the remainder going to commercial, industrial, medical, pharmaceutical, research, and food-preparation sectors. The company supports major military installations including Aberdeen Proving Ground, Picatinny Arsenal, Tobyhanna Army Depot, and Naval Air Systems Command, providing replacement parts for legacy systems such as the Trojan V3 Communication Shelter and Prophet Control.

CMF emphasizes a track record of zero financial defaults, zero litigation, zero lost-time injuries, and zero adverse actions from the EPA, OSHA, or NJDEP. The firm also differentiates itself through reverse-engineering expertise for obsolete or defective parts and a commitment to traditional business values.
